armor.light armor: Padded, Leather, Studded Leather - AC 11-12. No skill needed to wear.
armor.medium armor: Hide, Chain Shirt, Scale Mail, Breastplate, Half Plate - AC 13-15. DEX requirement for some.
armor.heavy armor: Ring Mail, Chain Mail, Splint, Plate - AC 14-18. STR requirement. Cannot use Stealth.
armor.shields: +2 AC. Requires one free hand. Can be used with any armor.

weapons.simple weapons: Clubs, Daggers, Greatclubs, Handaxes, Javelins, Light hammers, Maces, Quarterstaffs, Sickles, Spears, Unarmed strikes, Shortbows, Slings, Light crossbows. Basic weapons available to all.
weapons.martial weapons: Longswords, Battleaxes, Warhammers, Greataxes, Greatswords, Longbows, Heavy crossbows, Rapiers, Scimitars, Tridents, Polearms. Better weapons requiring training.
weapons.crossbows: Light/Heavy crossbows. Heavy requires two hands to fire, but deals more damage. Loading property means you can only fire once per attack action.
weapons.firearms: Pistols, Muskets, Rifles (if using firearms in your campaign).
weapons.improvised weapons: Any object can be used as a weapon. Typically deals 1d4 damage.
weapons.nets: Net. Ranged weapon that imposes the Grappled condition on hit.
weapons.unarmed strikes: 1 bludgeoning damage. No weapon proficiency needed.

tools.thieves' tools: Lockpicking and disabling traps. Used with Dexterity. Requires proficiency to add proficiency bonus.
tools.disguise kit: Creating disguises for infiltration. Used with Charisma (Deception).
tools.forgery kit: Creating fake documents. Used with Intelligence (Forgery).
tools.herbalism kit: Identifying and harvesting herbs, creating potions. Used with Wisdom (Medicine).
tools.poisoner's kit: Creating and applying poisons. Used with Intelligence.
tools.gaming set: Dice or cards for gambling games. Used with Charisma.
tools.smith's tools: Metalworking, repairing armor/weapons. Used with Strength.
tools.woodcarver's tools: Carving wood items. Used with Dexterity.
tools.alchemist's supplies: Creating alchemical items. Used with Intelligence.
tools.cook's utensils: Preparing food, detecting poison. Used with Wisdom.
tools.mason's tools: Stonework, creating walls. Used with Strength.
tools.carpenter's tools: Wood construction, creating structures. Used with Strength.

savingThrows.strength: Athletics checks, grappling, breaking objects. Resist force effects.
savingThrows.dexterity: Acrobatics, Stealth, Reflex saves. Avoiding fireballs, traps.
savingThrows.constitution: Endurance, poison resistance. Surviving harsh conditions.
savingThrows.intelligence: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion checks.
savingThrows.wisdom: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Perception, Survival checks.

mastery.strength: Mastery in Strength weapons: Attacks deal +1 damage, +2 at 5th level.
mastery.dexterity: Mastery in Dexterity weapons: Attacks deal +1 damage, +2 at 5th level.
mastery.versatile: Mastery for versatile weapons: +1 damage when wielding two-handed.

skills.Acrobatics: Balance, springs, flips. Used with Dexterity.
skills.Animal Handling: Handle, ride, care for animals. Used with Wisdom.
skills.Arcana: Recall lore about spells, magic items, etc. Used with Intelligence.
skills.Athletics: Climbing, swimming, jumps, grappling. Used with Strength.
skills.Deception: Bluffing, disguising, lying convincingly. Used with Charisma.
skills.History: Recall lore about historical events, people, artifacts. Used with Intelligence.
skills.Insight: Reading motives, detecting lies. Used with Wisdom.
skills.Intimidation: Frightening, coercing through threats. Used with Charisma.
skills.Investigation: Finding clues, analyzing evidence. Used with Intelligence.
skills.Medicine: Healing, diagnosing illness. Used with Wisdom.
skills.Nature: Knowledge of terrain, animals, weather. Used with Intelligence.
skills.Perception: Noticing danger, detecting hidden things. Used with Wisdom.
skills.Performance: Entertaining through music, dance, oratory. Used with Charisma.
skills.Persuasion: Negotiating, influencing through social grace. Used with Charisma.
skills.Religion: Knowledge of religious lore, gods, traditions. Used with Intelligence.
skills.Sleight of Hand: Palming, concealing small objects. Used with Dexterity.
skills.Stealth: Moving silently, hiding, avoiding detection. Used with Dexterity.
skills.Survival: Tracking, foraging, reading weather/signs. Used with Wisdom.
